document.title: Run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
document.summary: `scripts/vita3k.sh` builds the VPK and runs it with the example Deck Apps in an isolated Vita3K setup, and a new `vitadeck-emulator` skill documents setting it up on a new machine.
document.why: Testing the Vita build needed the device; this runs it in Vita3K on macOS, Windows and Linux ([PR #122](source:s1)).

sources.label: PR #122
sources.title: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
sources.gist: Vita3K script, emulator skill, staging script takes the data root.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 26
sources.gist: Máté asked for an emulator that runs VitaDeck on macOS and Windows, easy to run during development, then for the emulator usage as its own skill with docs for setting it up on another machine.

lookFor: Not tried on Windows: the Git Bash path conversion (`cygpath -m`) and the `winget` install line are untested ([PR #122](source:s1)).

groups.title: Staging takes a data root
groups.why: The emulator keeps the VitaDeck Data Root at `ux0/data/vitadeck`, not under a build directory, so staging needs the data root itself.
groups.summary: `stage-example-apps.sh` now takes the data root, and the `stage_examples` CMake target passes `<build>/vitadeck-data`, so host staging lands in the same place as before.

groups.title: scripts/vita3k.sh
groups.why: One command to build and run the Vita build in Vita3K during development ([session](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The script finds Vita3K, writes a config whose `pref-path` points at `~/.vitadeck/vita3k/fs`, stages the examples there, and passes the VPK to Vita3K, which installs and runs it.
lookFor: Every launch rewrites `~/.vitadeck/vita3k/config.yml`, so settings changed in Vita3K's own UI are lost on the next run.
Every launch replaces the staged example packages, so a Runtime Upload of an app with the same package name as an example (e.g. `timers.vdapp`) is overwritten by the local build on the next run.

groups.title: vitadeck-emulator skill
groups.why: Máté asked for the emulator usage as its own skill, with setup docs for another machine ([session](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The new skill holds new machine setup, controls, agent driving tips and the known Vita3K gaps; `AGENTS.md` and `vitadeck-build` only point to it.

commits.subject: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
scripts/vita3k.sh builds the VPK, installs it and the example Deck Apps into an isolated Vita3K setup under ~/.vitadeck/vita3k, and launches it on macOS, Windows (Git Bash) or Linux. The new vitadeck-emulator skill covers new machine setup, controls and the known emulator gaps.

stage-example-apps.sh now takes the data root, so it can stage into the emulated ux0:data/vitadeck.
